notes.title: SCP-049 PS Battle Winners!
notes.content:
Dear Researchers,

You have done incredible work tracing SCP-049's recent movements. Over 100 images were submitted by researchers across platforms and countries!

We are now honored to present our Favorite 3 entries. Each of the following will receive a DLC key upon release:

1. Taking the family to [redacted]world, by [url=https://twitter.com/HitenNoRurouni/status/1596201059315326976]@HitenNoRurouni[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/b4077a38765b7abd209d93c8e3897245c526c42d.png[/img]


2. Facing full-life consequences for medical malpractice, by [url=https://twitter.com/drtfountain/status/1596946062715293696]@DrTFountain[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/3c308ba23daa70eb44527f33cba146687a9100eb.png[/img]

3. Questioning research priorities, by [url=https://twitter.com/Real_Jar_Red/status/1596829166628134914]@Real_Jar_Red[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/e45dc52c57f57b085da77d0188a1cca280754b77.png[/img]

Finally, an honorable mention and bonus DLC key will be awarded to Super Archivist [url=https://twitter.com/ceart_v]@Ceart_V[/url], who contributed over 20 new files to our research.

To all entrants: It was an absolute pleasure for the Archive Department to catalog your entries! So many matched the above in creativity and enthusiasm, it was impossible to pick the "best." Instead, we tried to select winners that represented a variety of styles, and it was incredibly difficult.

Your love for SCP-049 clearly rivals our own. Now, we're even more hyped to him justice with our DLC, coming Q1 2023!

- The SCP Secret Files team

notes.title: Win SCP-049 DLC!
notes.content:
Win a SCP-049 DLC key by joining our Photoshop Battle!

Researchers, by now you've heard that SCP-049 is suspected to be active in ███. Reports of anomalous activity like ███ and ███ abound.

Where will SCP-049 be sighted next? What will be the consequences of his "research"? What exactly is his "cure"? Use your Photoshop skills to show us, and you could win a DLC key!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/22b33113f9555d79032437c0e6dd6b2ad97fc3af.jpg[/img]

How to Win
1. Download [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1y6-RVGKS_o36d9xrPDKA1r_f3I18Tcd0/view?usp=share_link]this image[/url] of SCP-049 on a blank background
2. Photoshop him into any location, engaging in whatever activity you imagine. The wackier the better (but SFW only... Yes, we have to specify this about 049)
3. Share your creation on Twitter or Instagram with the hashtag #SCP049SecretFiles by December 5

After the deadline, we will select our 3 favorites to each win a DLC key! 

Bonus: Retweet [url=https://twitter.com/files_scp/status/1596088399600832513]this event tweet [/url] and we will select 1 RTer to a key for the base game!

Notes:

(1) We will contact the winners via Twitter or Instagram DMs to confirm. If you are initially selected, but you do not respond to our initial outreach within 72 hours, you will forfeit your prize and an alternate winner will be selected.

(2) The DLC is expected to become available in Q1 2023. We will keep track of the winners and send their keys on release day.

notes.content:
Happy Thanksgiving, "Karl"! 

This year, we're thankful for every one of you rookie archivists. You've made SCP: Secret Files everything it is today!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/154a867606c12e2d39b1d3bfeae87d817d033915.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/427127e2225ff08f1e70af78d081a6a4deb4764c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/92227a92a24f9e8a1841e7247b763d0a7d481dc4.png[/img]

We were in amazing company with our fellow nominees. Your community support absolutely helped us receive such recognition, and enables us to keep up the exciting work! Looking forward to DLC.

Happy Thanksgiving!

notes.title: November Devlog | DLC and Digital Art Book Update!
notes.content:
Long time no see, Researchers. GameZoo here!

It's been a little over a month since SCP: Secret Files launched on Steam! We've received a humbling amount of praise and encouragement in that time. Ever since our studio was founded-- no, ever since the concept for Secret Files first took root in our brains!-- we've dreamed of nothing more than bringing this game to life. Indie studios always risk their road collapsing while they're in the middle of building it, and we truly could not have completed this journey without your support. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

Since launch, we have slowed down on public dev updates, but have no fear: we've had our heads down following up on those tasty breadcrumbs we left you in the game ([i][b]049 DLC[/b][/i], the main story follow up on 055, etc). By popular request, the digital concept art book is also underway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/53660bc545ebeb50a480382565183a508d3b3055.png[/img]

Speaking of DLC... The story will unfold with a unique perspective and atmosphere. We will stick to our creative vision: rejecting monotony, telling a different and fun story, and injecting some surprising gameplay (how about that gunplay you've all been asking about?). 049 is such a special entity -- he has power, elegance, and intellect; he embodies benevolence and malevolence in one form. You can't help but be drawn in by this "plague doctor" and his mysterious background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/77330ffb494ccbe72db599d6bd92b7237fcbc692.jpg[/img]
[b][i]DLC Character Art[/i][/b]

To create a story exclusively for him, we repeatedly redrafted and remodeled, polished and polished again, moving step-by-step closer to 049's dark yet fervent world. Finally, after much heated discussion, we've settled on our current rendering as ███.

Now we are in full swing to bring this idea to fruition. We sincerely hope that, by providing a unique, grounded narrative gaming experience, we can pass along this spark in our hearts to all of you other passionate fans of the Foundation and 049.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/5da4b7ff0ebbbd06790a8070a73f44ec61ec6fd4.jpg[/img]
[b][i]DLC Concept Art   [/i][/b] 

Right now, we're feeling great. Maybe the GZ-6 will become the GZ-8? It's looking like the SCP mega-series of our dreams may actually be possible! Of course, we can't hope to cover the whole SCP universe. After all, the wiki updates hundreds of times per day... No matter how fast we work, we'd still be left in the dust. For now, we're focused on the stories with strong narrative qualities, that jive with our main storyline, and that are most beloved by the community! So much to do, with so little time-- but that's life at the Foundation. 

We'll leave off here for now, since we've got bugs to hunt. Wish you all good health. And eat well: It puts you in the right mind to operate!


[b]We fight in the dark, so that you may live in the light.[/b]

notes.title: "The Foundation Reporter"
notes.content:
Dear "Karls", 
It is inevitable that you will have uncovered some interesting "news" related to Foundation anomalies while dealing with the secret files. For example, [i]could the Guatemalan sinkhole be related to SCP-994? What about the mysterious corpse found in the forest northwest of Yekaterinburg? And what caused the bizarre explosion at site-300-12?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/14a0e3188dcb8871ab262a2fc24e900a5030c2c8.jpg[/img]

Or perhaps you noticed those usual group announcements, such as: [i]no contact with SCP-999 during working hours; no verbal abuse, or you will be injected with amnestics; SCP-343's visiting hours are changed to 14:00 daily...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/b560e503acd2bec1a0c6f62ad7e6e1eb283b41a8.jpg[/img]

Now, the Foundation is authorizing YOU to create some brand site news and announcements. Submit your original content (it can be based on existing SCP content, but not directly plagiarized) in the form linked below, and we'll add our favourites to the game! The winner's name will also be added to the game's "thank you" list!

Rules:
1. Event time: Now - October 10th 
2. Submit your entries via this [url=https://forms.gle/kN19KaXeJLb8fyQP6]form[/url]
(if Steam blocks the form, simply copy the URL on the blocked page and paste into your browser)
3. You can write multiple entries, but each entry is limited to 100 words
4. We will add our favourites to the game
5. If your entry is chosen, we will contact you via the information you wrote in the form

notes.title: Demo Bug fixing: Version 0.1.24941 is up!
notes.content:
To all Field Personnel:

This is the Head of Archives Department, C·A.

On June 15th, we reported some problems with the "Demo-701" file. Task Force MTF-GZ6 took immediate action to minimize possible risks during the containment and research process.
The operation took about 30 hours in total, but our work is far from over. These secret files will always breed fresh chaos, and there will always be new challenges for us to face. We must remain vigilant at all times.

In the process, you—the Foundation's Field Personnel—contributed your unparalleled enthusiasm and precise judgment to make the containment of these items as safe and as smooth as possible.
The Archives Department would like to express our sincere thanks for your dedication.

Currently, the repair operation is still ongoing. Please refer to the [b]list of changes[/b] below:

- Fixed an issue where the camera could not be turned in certain scenes
- Optimized text descriptions and localization
- Removed unnecessary invisible walls
- Optimized performance in some areas
- Fixed an issue where the language setting could not be saved

We fight in the dark so that you may live in the light

Head of Archives Department, C·A

notes.title: Demo Bug fixing: Version 0.0.24897 is up!
notes.content:
To all Field Personnel:

       As you know, the Foundation has recently recruited a number of capable and courageous Field Agents—you!—to conduct a preliminary investigation into the project code-named "Demo-701".
       To begin with,  please allow me to show a great appreciation to every agent who provided us with feedback. We immediately gathered your opinions and conclusions in order to draw up a detailed file report which was then submitted to relevant Site Directors.
       Consequently, the Foundation has determined that a number of discrepancies currently exist within "Demo-701". We have contacted MTF-GZ6 to resolve some of these issues, and the rest will be        addressed soon.
       We expect the project to be accessible in a more secure manner once it has been updated on the control panel.

       Please refer to the update list below for details:
- Fixed an issue where the character sometimes gets stuck in the game
- Fixed an issue where the camera occasionally gets stuck when turning
- Optimized collection system prompts - players will no longer be prompted to collect combat gadgets
- Optimized the collection system switch button - press TAB to open/close the collection
- Added flashlight power button - press F to turn on/off the flashlight
- Optimized the hitbox of the clock puzzle to improve usability
- Slightly increased the character's walking speed 
- Adjusted mouse sensitivity and synchronized X- and Y-axis movement speed
- Added an option to adjust mouse sensitivity in the settings 
- Added an option to invert Y axis in the settings
- Optimized the interact prompt
- Optimized flashlight brightness
- Added a prompt to sprint - hold shift to speed up
- Fixed an issue where SteamVR would automatically be turned on when launching the game
                                                                                                                    
                                                                               We fight in the dark so that you may live in the light
                                                                                        Head of Archives Department, C · A
